title: Renewal, Expiration and Late Renewal of Bridgewell Homeowner Service Contracts
content:
Bridgewell issues one renewal notice per term on each Homeowner Service Contract, stating the renewal tier, service call fee option and price.

**Automatic renewal.** A contract with automatic renewal turned on renews automatically on its term end only when the renewal notice for the expiring term was issued at least the renewal-notice lead time (in calendar days) before the term end date; counting runs backward from the term end date, and a notice issued exactly that many days before the term end date qualifies.

**Expiry and affirmative renewal.** When automatic renewal is off, or the renewal notice was not issued in time, the contract expires at the end of the term end date unless the customer affirmatively asks to renew before then, in which case it renews on the terms stated for the renewal. The customer may turn automatic renewal off or on at any time before the term end date.

**The renewed term.** A renewed term starts the day after the prior term end date and keeps continuous coverage with no new waiting period. A downgrade to a lower tier or a change of service call fee option takes effect only at renewal; items no longer covered after a downgrade stop being covered on the new term start date, and service requests opened before then are completed under the prior tier. Per-item caps, the aggregate limit and the refrigerant allowance restart with each new term.

**Late renewal.** An expired contract may be renewed within the late-renewal grace period (in calendar days) after its term end without a new waiting period; the count starts the day after the term end date and the boundary day itself qualifies. A late renewal starts a new full term on the late renewal date, and failures that began between the term end and the late renewal are not covered. After the late-renewal grace period an expired contract cannot be renewed and the customer must purchase a new contract with a new waiting period.

The notice date, the term end date, the automatic-renewal setting and the status are read from the contract record.

### Boundary cases (hypothetical, term ending December 31; 45-day notice lead time; 30-day late-renewal grace period)

| Fact | Count | Outcome |
|---|---|---|
| Automatic renewal on, notice issued November 16 | exactly 45 days before December 31 | issued in time; renews automatically |
| Automatic renewal on, notice issued November 17 | 44 days before | not in time; expires unless the customer affirmatively asks to renew before the end of December 31 |
| Expired, renewal asked for on January 30 | day 30 after term end | late renewal allowed; new full term starts January 30 |
| Expired, renewal asked for on January 31 | day 31 | cannot be renewed; a new contract with a new waiting period is needed |

### Basis Q&A

**Does a late-renewed contract cover a failure that began on January 10 in the example above?** No: failures that began between the term end and the late renewal are not covered.

**When does a downgrade chosen at renewal change coverage?** On the new term start date; requests opened before that date are completed under the prior tier.
